column1: A compact summary of one finished piece of work: what happened, tools used, files touched and lessons found. Kept after raw observations are pruned.
column2: 对一项已完成工作的紧凑总结：发生了什么、用了哪些工具、动了哪些文件、发现了哪些经验。原始观测被清理后仍会保留。

column1: A follow-up the agent tracked: a task, a decision to revisit, something blocked on input. Moves pending, active, done or blocked.
column2: agent 跟踪的待办：一个任务、一个待重新审视的决定，或某个卡在等待输入的事项。状态在待处理、进行中、已完成或已阻塞之间流转。

column1: Actions that are unblocked and ready to pick up next. Everything they depend on is done.
column2: 已解除阻塞、可以接着做的行动。它们依赖的一切都已完成。

column1: One run of an agent in a project, from start to end. Observations belong to a session.
column2: agent 在一个项目中的一次完整运行（从开始到结束）。观测从属于会话。

column1: Active means the agent is still running and sending observations. Completed means the session ended.
column2: 进行中表示 agent 仍在运行并持续发送观测；已完成表示会话已结束。

column1: The working directory an agent ran in. Memories, sessions and lessons are grouped by project.
column2: agent 运行所在的工作目录。记忆、会话和经验教训按项目分组。

column1: Which agent or role wrote a record (for example coder or reviewer). Used to keep multi-agent memories apart.
column2: 写入该记录的 agent 或角色（例如 coder 或 reviewer）。用于区分多 agent 的记忆。

column1: A background step that turns many raw observations into fewer, longer-lived records: semantic facts and procedures. It needs an LLM provider.
column2: 一个后台步骤，把大量原始观测收敛为更少、更持久的记录：语义事实和流程。它需要 LLM 提供方。

column1: General facts distilled from many sessions ("the API uses jose for JWT"). Produced by consolidation.
column2: 从众多会话中提炼的通用事实（“该 API 用 jose 处理 JWT”）。由整合产生。

column1: Records that are never used lose strength or confidence over time, so stale knowledge stops crowding out fresh knowledge.
column2: 从不被使用的记录会随时间流失强度或置信度，从而避免陈旧知识挤占新知识。

column1: How many times the lesson was confirmed again: saved again with the same text by any agent, or strengthened with memory_lesson_strengthen. Each use raises confidence and restarts the decay clock.
column2: 该经验教训被再次确认的次数：任何 agent 用相同文本重新保存，或用 memory_lesson_strengthen 强化。每次使用都会提升置信度并重置衰减计时。

column1: Rules agentmemory infers from the files and concepts above: TypeScript when .ts files outnumber .js, a src/ layout when most files sit under src/, tests when test or spec files appear, and any concept that came up 3 or more times.
column2: agentmemory 从上述文件和概念推断出的规则：.ts 文件多于 .js 时判定为 TypeScript；多数文件位于 src/ 下时判定为 src/ 布局；出现 test 或 spec 文件时判定有测试；以及任何出现 3 次及以上的概念。

column1: Unblocked and ready to pick up next: every action it depends on is done. memory_frontier returns these first.
column2: 已解除阻塞、可以接着做：它依赖的每个行动都已完成。memory_frontier 会优先返回这些。

column1: Where a memory came from: the sessions and observations it was distilled from. Memories saved directly with memory_save or the REST API have none.
column2: 记忆的来源：它是从哪些会话和观测中提炼出来的。直接用 memory_save 或 REST API 保存的记忆没有来源。

column1: What changed from the previous version. Struck-through words were removed, highlighted words were added.
column2: 与上一版本的差异。删除线表示被移除的词，高亮表示新增的词。

column1: The older memory this one replaced. The old version is kept for history but no longer returned by search.
column2: 被本条取代的旧记忆。旧版本会保留以供追溯，但不再由搜索返回。

column1: Where a record came from: an agent tool call, an automatic hook, an import or a user action.
column2: 记录的来源：agent 工具调用、自动钩子、导入或用户操作。

column1: The full-text index used for keyword search. It holds observations, memories and lessons, so its document count is usually higher than the observation count.
column2: 用于关键词搜索的全文索引。它包含观测、记忆和经验教训，所以文档数通常高于观测数。

column1: Observations that are searchable. The keyword index also contains memories and lessons, which is why its total is larger.
column2: 可被检索的观测。关键词索引还包含记忆和经验教训，这就是它总数更大的原因。

column1: Every observation a hook sends is written here first and removed once it is stored. If storing fails or the server restarts, it is retried instead of lost. Dead letters are the ones that still failed after every retry.
column2: 钩子发送的每条观测都会先写入这里，入库后移除。如果入库失败或服务重启，会重试而不是丢失。死信是重试全部失败后仍未成功的那些。

column1: A small file on this machine where hooks keep observations when the server is down or does not answer. It is sent automatically on the next hook call and at every start, and each observation carries an event id so nothing is stored twice.
column2: 本机上的一个小文件：当服务不可用或没有响应时，钩子把观测暂存在这里。下次钩子调用和每次启动时会自动补发，每条观测都带事件 ID，确保不会重复入库。

column1: Records waiting for an embedding so they can be found by meaning, not only by keywords.
column2: 等待生成向量的记录，以便按语义而不只是关键词被找到。

column1: How many relations touch this node. Nodes with more relations are drawn larger and get their labels first.
column2: 与该节点相连的关系数量。关系越多的节点绘制得越大，标签也优先显示。

column1: The observations that mentioned this entity, the sessions and projects they belong to, and memories distilled from the same observations or naming this entity. Imported code-graph nodes show the import instead.
column2: 提到该实体的观测、它们所属的会话与项目，以及从相同观测中提炼或直接点名该实体的记忆。导入的代码图谱节点则显示导入来源。

column1: Nodes with no relation yet. They sit in the dashed box under the graph until an observation mentions them together with another entity.
column2: 尚无任何关系的节点。在有观测把它们与另一个实体一同提到之前，它们会待在图下方的虚线框里。

column1: One entity in the knowledge graph, such as a file, a function, a library or a concept.
column2: 知识图谱中的一个实体，例如文件、函数、库或概念。

column1: A relation between two entities, such as "uses", "fixes" or "depends on".
column2: 两个实体之间的关系，例如 “uses”“fixes” 或 “depends on”。

column1: Protects against a failing LLM provider. Closed means calls go through normally. Open means too many recent failures, so calls are paused briefly. Half-open means it is testing whether the provider recovered.
column2: 防止 LLM 提供方故障拖垮系统。闭合表示调用正常放行；断开表示近期失败过多，调用被短暂暂停；半开表示正在试探提供方是否已恢复。

column1: How many times agentmemory functions (observe, search, remember, summarize and so on) ran since the worker started, with their failure counts.
column2: 自 worker 启动以来 agentmemory 各函数（observe、search、remember、summarize 等）的调用次数及失败次数。

column1: A rough estimate of prompt tokens saved by injecting a compact memory context instead of replaying every observation. It assumes about 80 tokens per observation and a 2,000 token budget per session.
column2: 粗略估计：用紧凑的记忆上下文注入代替回放每条观测所节省的提示词 token。按每条观测约 80 token、每会话 2,000 token 预算估算。

column1: JavaScript memory the worker is using, compared with the limit it may grow to. Warnings only matter when the process is also large overall.
column2: worker 正在使用的 JavaScript 内存，以及它可增长到的上限。只有在进程整体占用也很大时，警告才需要在意。

column1: Total memory the worker process holds from the operating system, including code and buffers.
column2: worker 进程从操作系统持有的内存总量，包括代码和缓冲区。

column1: How long the agentmemory worker has been running since it last started.
column2: agentmemory worker 自上次启动以来的运行时长。

column1: Healthy means everything is normal. Degraded means something needs attention but memory still works. Critical means a core part is failing.
column2: 正常表示一切如常；降级表示有需要注意的地方但记忆功能仍可用；严重表示某个核心部分已失效。

column1: A record of every change agentmemory made to stored data: saves, deletes, imports, consolidation runs. Use it to see who changed what and when.
column2: agentmemory 对存储数据所做每次变更的记录：保存、删除、导入、整合运行。用它查看谁在何时改了什么。

column1: Share of calls that failed. Functions that need an LLM show as off, not failing, when no LLM provider is set.
column2: 调用失败的占比。未配置 LLM 提供方时，需要 LLM 的函数会显示为关闭，而不是失败。

column1: Rebuild the profile from the latest sessions and memories now instead of using the cached copy
column2: 立即用最新的会话和记忆重建项目画像，而不是使用缓存副本

column1: Record one more use: confidence rises and the decay clock restarts
column2: 再记录一次使用：置信度上升，衰减计时重新开始
